summary: Backend-only testing pass for Sales Monitor app. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering health, sales/admin auth (success + failure), RBAC (sales↔admin isolation, missing/invalid JWT), /me, stock endpoints (stok_sales & stok_gudang), admin config, admin sync (verified counts 28/65/2/258/46), sales transaction with stock deduction & insufficient-stock validation, loading transaction moving stock gudang→sales, transaction history (sales + admin), admin password change with rollback. Program-berjalan bonus test skipped because sales 277 does not carry kode_produk 370072 with sufficient stock — this is data-dependent, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: password stored/compared in plaintext for both sales (from sheet) and admin config. Acceptable for internal-sheet-driven app, but flag if security matters.
server.py: admin/sync deletes then re-inserts collections — no transaction, so a mid-sync failure leaves DB partially wiped. Consider staging before swap.
server.py: to_int uses replace('.', '') which strips decimal separators — works for Indonesian formatting but will misparse '1.5' as 15. Acceptable given source data is integer qty.
server.py: stok_sales.qty can go negative if concurrent txns race (check-then-decrement is not atomic). Consider using $inc with filter {qty:{$gte:total_deduct}} to enforce atomically.

server.py: program_berjalan bonus is trusted from client (bonus_qty in payload). Server does not validate against the program rules — a client could send arbitrary bonus_qty to deduct extra stock. Consider server-side computation.
server.py: /admin/config saves via SheetConfig which forces all 5 fields; a partial save (e.g., updating only one URL) overwrites others with empty string. Consider allowing PATCH semantics.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 passed, 1 skipped due to data availability)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Transactions inserted during tests use notes prefixed TEST_ for identification. Stock deducted minimally (qty=1). Admin password rolled back to admin123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. If frontend testing is needed next, use kode 277/12345 for sales login and admin123 for admin. Stock levels have been slightly reduced by tests (a few units on stok_sales for sales 277 and a stok_gudang item). Admin can run Sync Sekarang to restore. Program-berjalan bonus flow was not exercised via API (skipped); worth exercising through UI at /penjualan if sales carrying kode 370072 (e.g. backup sales 79) is used.
